project.name: MoneyFlow
project.mission: A calm, manual-first Vietnamese personal income-and-expense ledger that helps one person record transactions, know balances, understand monthly cash flow, correct mistakes, and export trustworthy data.
project.targetUser: A Vietnamese individual managing their own money without accounting jargon, bank aggregation, or automated financial advice.
project.currentPhase: Calm Ledger foundation and landing/auth implementation
firstCriticalFlow: sign in or use the supported runtime mode
record an income, expense, or balanced transfer
see balances and period reporting update correctly
nonGoals: AI financial advice or autonomous money decisions
a native mobile app before the web product proves daily usefulness

foundation.frontend: Next.js App Router with React and TypeScript
foundation.styling: Tailwind CSS with repository-owned design tokens and reusable components
foundation.data: Supabase PostgreSQL for authenticated mode and browser-local storage for demo mode

invariants: VND is stored as integer đồng and never floating-point money
internal transfers balance and never count as income or expense
user-owned records are isolated by RLS and ownership constraints
financial calculations live in testable domain modules rather than UI components
missing financial or planning data remains unknown and is never guessed
exports preserve Vietnamese text, integer values, and spreadsheet formula safety
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE is explicit and missing configuration must fail instead of changing modes silently
unknowns: whether the Calm Ledger token consolidation can be completed without visual regressions
whether the landing and authentication slice communicates the product clearly on supported viewports
whether the redesign preserves financial, ownership, export, and runtime-mode invariants
